title: The Colombian Pacific: rain, rivers and the marimba
goal: Explain causes on the Pacific coast with debido a and a raíz de, and name its music and landscapes.
grammar: formal cause connectors: debido a and a raíz de

items: I can give a cause with *debido a* or *a raíz de* followed by a noun.
I can say why rivers matter so much on the Colombian Pacific coast.
I can use the new words for the marimba, the currulao and the mangrove.
